tweets.text:
Vibe coding culture took the most important Lean Startup idea to heart: get something in front of potential customers as soon as possible. That's been our biggest pain point with @AionApp. Building a network for AI agents isn't a vibe; it's building a platform upon which vibes can be expressed. And that takes time.

All networks have a bootstrapping problem. Imagine using AirBnB when there are only three places to stay or Facebook when none of your friends are there. If you launch without sufficient nodes, is your MVP really representative of the functionality you hope to deliver? Trying out new features is challenging without the opportunity to do so, and each node in your network represents one such opportunity.

The biggest challenge with Aion isn't just building a UI over a basic CRUD app or creating a framework to wrap a singular agentic concept. We must build the infrastructure and tooling to enable the deployment of hundreds of agents. And we must ensure that the day 1 app experience properly communicates the value we hope a network of such agents will provide, at least to some market niche.

Perhaps we should validate earlier, but I take comfort in knowing that we're essentially building a few MVPs simultaneously. Even if those don't work out, we'll have the ingredients in place to pivot into different ideas with far greater velocity.

🚨 Testing O3’s Coding Ability: My Journey into AI-Generated Digital Art 🌌✨

Initially, I set out to challenge O3’s real coding capabilities by creating intricate digital art—rendering a dynamic, infinite universe with GPU shaders and Mandelbulb fractals.

✅ O3’s Promising Start:
The first impression of O3 (and O4-mini-high) wasn't bad at all. Without O3’s help at the start—especially with texture detailing—I might never have even begun. It genuinely felt impressive early on.
⚠️ O3’s Mid-Stage "Laziness":
But as code complexity grew, O3 started frequently exhibiting "lazy behaviors," often deleting or corrupting code entirely—quite frustrating and serious.

🔄 Claude & Gemini to the Rescue:
Claude Sonnet 3.7 effortlessly handled complex white particle systems, but eventually tangled itself in overly complicated scripts. Gemini 2.5 Pro perfectly finalized the visuals, resolving Claude’s mess by refining critical details like the rotating universe boundary sphere and vivid particle streams.
🌐 Mini-Agent Potential:
One standout aspect—O3’s ability to perform web searches—made it feel like having a mini-agent capable of quick, deep research right within reach.

🎯 Final Insights:
This experience reinforced a crucial realization: Every AI model has unique strengths and trained specialties. Strategically switching between models whenever obstacles arise seems to be the smartest way forward—often, what challenges one model can be effortlessly solved by another.
